# Blé Pastry & Bakery

> Event, party and finger-food catering from a bakery in Muscat, Oman. Savory and sweet boxes, bruschetta, bottled drinks, Persian and Omani dishes, wedding and occasion cakes. Site in English, Arabic and Persian. No fixed price list: each proposal is quoted personally.

## Pages
- [English](https://bleoman.com/): menu, packages (Gathering 10-25 guests, Party 25-60, Event 60+), FAQ, consultation form
- [العربية](https://bleoman.com/ar): same content in Arabic
- [فارسی](https://bleoman.com/fa): same content in Persian
